commands.stdout:
usage: alpha-agent successor-study [-h] --output OUTPUT
                                   {create,approve,train,confirm,show,export,pause,resume,cancel,operation-example,operation-start,operation-run,operation-status,operation-export,operation-stop}
                                   ...

positional arguments:
  {create,approve,train,confirm,show,export,pause,resume,cancel,operation-example,operation-start,operation-run,operation-status,operation-export,operation-stop}
    create              Propose exact purpose, policies, budgets and whole-
                        sample design
    approve             Approve the exact free local study binding
    train               Run complete campaigns from a separately supplied
                        batch
    confirm             Run complete campaigns from a separately supplied
                        batch
    show                Inspect or control the durable study
    export              Inspect or control the durable study
    pause               Inspect or control the durable study
    resume              Inspect or control the durable study
    cancel              Inspect or control the durable study
    operation-example   Write a finite synthetic source-operation envelope
    operation-start     Approve and run one exact bounded source operation
    operation-run       Run, inspect, export or permanently stop the existing
                        operation
    operation-status    Run, inspect, export or permanently stop the existing
                        operation
    operation-export    Run, inspect, export or permanently stop the existing
                        operation
    operation-stop      Run, inspect, export or permanently stop the existing
                        operation

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT       New evidence file; never overwrite an artifact
